_comment: The audition scene. A short contiguous run from Chapter 1 that exercises every
transition we care about: narration into a system readout, a system readout into
dialogue, dialogue into narration, and a change of speaker.
Generate it with:  python3 scripts/audio.py generate --scene
It costs only these clips, and it is the thing to listen to before committing to

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jack entered a command and pulled up the laboratory access logs. Nothing looked unusual. He tried another search and got the same result.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The system beeped, and a directory opened by itself. Jack stopped typing when he recognized the folder.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He immediately locked the terminal. The screen went black for three seconds, then came back on and reopened the same directory.
